ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in the isosceles triangle $ABC$, where $AB=AC$ and $BD\perp AC$, with $\angle ABC=70^\circ$, what is the value of $\angle DBC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since AB = AC, \\
thus $\angle$ACB = $\angle$ABC = 70°, \\
Since BD $\perp$ AC, \\
thus $\angle$BDC = 90°, \\
hence $\angle$DBC = 90° - $\angle$ACB = \boxed{20°}.
